messages:
Noah L.: Hey team, day 1 and stuck. Okta says 'device attestation required' and my 1Password invite hasn't arrived. Google sign-in times out. Anyone know if People Ops needs to enable my seat? Screenshot: https://redwood-internal/diags/noah-okta.png
Maya Chen: Welcome Noah! Can you share your company email so I can check provisioning? :wave:
Noah L.: noah.l@redwood.ai
IT-Bot: Ticket IT-4932 created for noah.l@redwood.ai assigned to Maya Chen. ETA 20-40m.
Ravi P.: FYI we pushed a bulk grant last night but one or two accounts in eng-new-joins missed the group sync. Maya can re-run the provisioning job.
Maya Chen: I see your Okta record but group missing. Re-running identity sync and reissued SAML assertion.
People Ops: Reminder: complete laptop preference form to receive managed device offer. Link: https://redwood-internal/hr/onboard/2398765432
Noah L.: thanks - quick Q: I have a YubiKey. Okta's flow only offered phone + passkey. Can I register the hardware key?
Maya Chen: Yes, we allow hardware keys. Policy default shows phone+passkey; I can enable U2F for your account. Reply if you want it flipped.
IT-Bot: Identity sync job completed. Groups updated: eng-new-joins.
Noah L.: trying login again 12; Google sign-in worked. 1Password still pending.
IT-Bot: 1Password provisioning queued, invite will be resent after MFA enrollment.
Noah L.: Got 1Password invite, set up vault. Enabled YubiKey registration and added SSH key to vault. Google Drive still missing 'eng-resources' folder.
Maya Chen: Added you to Drive group eng-resources, ACLs pushed.
Noah L.: Drive visible now. All good. Thanks everyone for the quick response :raised_hands:
Maya Chen: Welcome aboard Noah! Join #eng and the onboarding session at 3pm if you can.
Noah L.: Will do, appreciate it :tada:
